description: An agent-based model simulating the spread of mask-wearing behavior through a social network influenced by social connections and government interventions.

parameters.connection_weights: Different weights for family, work/school, and community

behaviors.name: wear_mask
behaviors.description: Agents decide to wear a mask based on social influence and personal risk perception.
behaviors.algorithm: Agents compare their risk perception with a threshold and are influenced by their social network's mask-wearing behavior.

behaviors.name: influence_others
behaviors.description: Agents influence their connections to adopt mask-wearing behavior.
behaviors.algorithm: Agents spread their mask-wearing behavior to their network connections with a probability proportional to the influence factor.

behaviors.name: be_influenced
behaviors.description: Agents change their mask-wearing behavior based on received information and social influence.

parameters.information_influence_factor: Estimated from correlation between received_info and wearing_mask

behaviors.algorithm: Agents update their behavior based on the influence from their network and information received.

interactions.name: influence_interaction
interactions.description: Individuals influence each other to adopt mask-wearing behavior based on social influence and network connections.
interactions.effect: Changes in mask-wearing status based on interactions within the network.

algorithms.create_influence_paths: Breadth-first search for influence path creation

data_sources.name: agent_attributes.csv
data_sources.purpose: Initialize agent attributes and initial behaviors

data_sources.name: social_network.json
data_sources.purpose: Define social network connections and structure

data_sources.name: train_data.csv
data_sources.purpose: Train the model on historical mask-wearing behavior

files.name: main.py
files.description: Main script to run the simulation

files.name: agent.py
files.description: Defines the Person entity and its behaviors

files.name: network.py
files.description: Defines the SocialNetwork entity and its behaviors

files.name: utils.py
files.description: Utility functions for data processing and analysis
